yi-hsuan-hung.role:
National Taiwan Normal University
Dean, College of Technology and Engineering
Distinguished Professor, Graduate Institute and Undergraduate Program of Vehicle and Energy Engineering
yi-hsuan-hung.fields:
Teaching Areas

  • System dynamics and control strategies for fuel cells, supercapacitors, and lithium-ion batteries
  • Design and modeling of hybrid and electric vehicles
  • Advanced vehicle control and energy management
  • Optimal and nonlinear control theory and applications
  • System dynamics and real-time simulation
yi-hsuan-hung.details:
Education
  • Ph.D., Power Mechanical Engineering, National Tsing Hua University
  • M.S., Power Mechanical Engineering, National Tsing Hua University
Experience and Professional Service

Academic and Educational Roles

  • Dean, College of Technology and Engineering, NTNU
  • Associate Dean, College of Technology and Engineering, NTNU
  • Deputy Director, Graduate Institute of Green Energy and Sustainable Technology, College of Interdisciplinary Industry-Academia Innovation, NTNU
  • Director, Graduate Institute and Undergraduate Program of Vehicle and Energy Engineering, NTNU

Former Appointments

  • Director, Innovation & Incubation Center, National Taiwan Normal University
  • Associate Vice President for Research and Development, National Taiwan Normal University
  • Co-founder, Neopower Technologies Co., Ltd.

Industry and Research

  • Visiting Scholar, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor
  • Principal Investigator for hybrid vehicle projects, Bureau of Energy, Ministry of Economic Affairs

Professional Service

  • Board Member, Society of Automotive Engineers, Taiwan
  • Reviewer for major programs, Ministry of Economic Affairs
  • Reviewer for Ministry of Science and Technology projects and international journals
  • Chief Judge for creative competitions including the International Exhibition for Young Inventors and World GreenMech
Awards and Honors
  • ITRI Industry–Academia Excellence Award
  • NTNU Distinguished Professor (Academic Category)
  • NTNU Industry–Academia Excellence Award for five consecutive years; Technology Transfer Award
  • Awards for outstanding talent; Ministry of Science and Technology Outstanding Young Researcher Project
  • Education Award, Chinese Industrial Vocational Education Association; NTNU Distinguished Teaching Award
  • Outstanding Teaching Award, NTNU College of Technology
  • Gold Prize in the Yulon Nissan Innovation Award for three consecutive editions
